name: Propane Canister
description: Guidelines for traveling with propane canister in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Propane, butane, and other compressed fuel canisters are strictly prohibited in carry-on baggage.

checkedBag.reason: Propane and camp fuel canisters are strictly prohibited in checked baggage holds as hazardous materials.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring propane canister on a plane?

travelTips: Propane, butane, and other compressed fuel canisters are strictly prohibited in carry-on baggage.

faq.question: Is propane canister allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Propane Canister is not_allowed in carry-on luggage. Propane, butane, and other compressed fuel canisters are strictly prohibited in carry-on baggage.

faq.question: Can you pack propane canister in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Propane Canister is not allowed in checked bags. Propane and camp fuel canisters are strictly prohibited in checked baggage holds as hazardous materials.
